dct_description_sm:
Refer to the file: Tom_Br_2021_to_2023_readme.txt for explanations on the content of the files and interpretation of the terms used and ratings recorded.
This project was funded by the Ontario Tomato Research Institute (University of Guelph trust fund/project 055014).

Field observations of traits on processing tomato selections made in 2021, 2022 and 2023.  There are numeric data on days from transplanting to 80 percent red ripe and weeks fruit quality held after reaching 80 percent red ripe.  There are text-based data recording the breeder's ratings for important selection criteria and candid comments on strengths and weaknesses of the selections.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Processing tomato breeding 2021 to 2023
